text: The Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) operates its off-street parking facilities under two basic formats - controlled or gated facilities, and uncontrolled facilities relying on proof-of-payment arrangements. The majority of facilities fall under the latter operation, comprising in the order of 200 sites and approximately 20,000 spaces. More specifically, customers have two choices for payment of the parking fees at these uncontrolled sites; namely, the purchase of a receipt from a pay-and-display machine, which then must be physically placed on the vehicle dash; or through a virtual payment using the Green P app on their mobile device. Enforcement is a key element of the program in encouraging payment compliance at these facilities.
